questions.explanation: Ethene (C2H4) is the smallest alkene. There is no 'methene' because you need at least two carbon atoms to form a C=C double bond. Ethene has the structure CH2=CH2.

questions.stem: How are alkenes typically produced industrially?

options.text: By cracking long-chain hydrocarbons from crude oil
By combining carbon and hydrogen directly

questions.explanation: Alkenes are produced industrially by cracking long-chain hydrocarbons from crude oil. During cracking, large alkane molecules are broken down into shorter, more useful alkanes and alkenes. Alkenes are not found directly in crude oil.
